description: facebook: Event Details. GET /v1/facebook/event/details. Get a public Facebook event by its URL or id: name, description, start and end time, place, address, coordinates, hosts, attendance and interested counts. going_count is not on the logged-out page and is omitted. Deleted and private events redirect to a login and fail at 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

url.description: The URL of the event, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/events/1705359837159507/

name: facebook_event_details
